Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace. In standard policy-rule terms (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler), holding the funds rate in a restrictive range while growth and employment remain strong is consistent with steering inflation back toward target. The explicit nod to greater uncertainty and readiness to adjust policy tracks the gradualism and risk-management prescriptions under uncertainty (Söderström 2002; Wieland 2000). Operationally, slowing Treasury runoffs while using administered rates and standing facilities (Goodfriend 2002; interest on reserves since October 2008) reflects a floor-system approach that can ease term premia marginally without changing the headline stance. Net tone: mildly positive on activity, tempered by elevated inflation and higher uncertainty.
